title: The repository: one source of truth, cache and refresh

videos.script: You have a database and you have a server. Today they get one rule between them. {{rule}} The screen reads only the database. The network only writes into it. That rule has a name, a single source of truth, and a class that keeps it: the repository. {{repository}} You will build it from the pieces of the last two lessons. A DAO, an API, and about forty lines in between. {{refresh}} Then the question of when to ask the server again. Not on every screen. Every fifteen minutes, with time moved by hand in a test. {{offline}} Then the server goes down. First with an error, then not at all. The week keeps every session it had. {{write}} Then a session added on a train. It is on screen at once, and waits to be sent. {{fakes}} And last, the same repository tested with fakes: no database, no server, and the same answers.
